name: Personal Savings Account Opening and ISA Subscription
orchestration_notes: Customer applies for a savings account or ISA via a channel. CAP-001 (Retail Banking) owns the savings account lifecycle and ISA subscription management. CAP-005 (Compliance) receives account opening events for AML/KYC monitoring. The ISA subscription is HMRC-governed — the bank notifies HMRC of ISA subscriptions via the annual ISA return.

regulatory_basis.legislation: Individual Savings Account Regulations 1998 (ISA Regulations) as amended
sections: Regulation 5 — ISA subscription limits (£20,000 annual per person)
regulatory_basis.obligation: The bank as ISA account manager must ensure: subscriber is a UK resident aged 18+; subscription does not exceed the annual ISA allowance; the ISA wrapper is applied correctly (interest/gains are tax-free). Annual ISA returns submitted to HMRC.

regulatory_basis.legislation: FCA Handbook — BCOBS (Banking: Conduct of Business sourcebook)
regulatory_basis.obligation: Clear, fair, and not misleading pre-contractual information about account features, interest rates, and ISA rules. Consumer Duty fair value assessment required.
Savings product must offer fair value. Interest rate must be appropriate relative to base rate and competitive market. Annual fair value assessment required.

sections: Deposit protection up to £85,000 per eligible depositor
regulatory_basis.obligation: FSCS protection information must be prominently communicated at account opening.

phases.name: Product Selection and Eligibility Check
phases.description: Customer browses savings products via the channel and selects a savings account (easy access, fixed-term, or notice) or a Cash ISA. Channel presents product features, AER, FSCS protection status, and ISA rules if applicable. Eligibility checks are performed: age (18+), UK residency, existing ISA subscription within tax year (ISA only).
persona_actions: Customer selects product type: easy access savings / fixed-term savings / Cash ISA
Customer confirms eligibility (18+, UK resident, has not exceeded ISA allowance for current tax year)
system_actions: SVC-001 presents product catalogue with AER, terms, FSCS status
If ISA selected: SVC-001 checks customer's existing ISA subscriptions for current tax year (via ISA allowance check)
SVC-001 validates age (>= 18) and UK residency from existing Customer record (ENT-001)
If customer has already subscribed to a Cash ISA with another provider in current tax year: display ineligibility message (split ISA rules)
phases.exit_condition: Product selected; eligibility confirmed; customer proceeds to application

phases.name: KYC Verification and Account Application
phases.description: If the customer does not have an existing relationship with the bank (new customer), full KYC/CDD is performed. For existing customers, the existing KYC status is checked. The customer completes the account application: confirms personal details, selects initial deposit amount, confirms ISA declaration (for ISA products), and provides source of funds (for deposits above AML threshold).
persona_actions: Customer confirms personal details (name, address, date of birth, National Insurance number for ISA)
Customer provides source of funds if initial deposit > £10,000
Customer completes ISA declaration (for Cash ISA): 'I declare I have not subscribed to another Cash ISA in this tax year'
Customer completes SCA to confirm application
system_actions: SVC-014 (KYC/AML) checks existing Customer record for valid KYC — if existing KYC current: no new checks required
If new customer or KYC expired: SVC-014 runs electronic identity verification (eIDV) and AML screening
SVC-001 creates SavingsAccountApplication with status = submitted
SVC-001 publishes SavingsAccountApplicationSubmitted (EVT-148)
SVC-100 (IAM) validates SCA completion for application confirmation
SVC-014 consumes SavingsAccountApplicationSubmitted for AML monitoring
phases.exit_condition: Application submitted; KYC validated; SavingsAccountApplicationSubmitted published

phases.name: Account Provisioning
phases.description: SVC-001 creates the savings account or ISA wrapper. An account number, sort code, and (for ISA) ISA subscription record are created. The ISA subscription year, allowance used, and remaining allowance are recorded. FSCS protection is confirmed. The new account is linked to the customer's profile.
persona_actions: No customer action required — system processes application
system_actions: SVC-001 creates SavingsAccount: account_number, sort_code, account_type, status = active
If ISA: SVC-001 creates IsaSubscriptionRecord: tax_year, subscription_used = 0, annual_allowance = 20000, isa_type = cash
SVC-001 publishes SavingsAccountOpened (EVT-149)
SVC-015 (Compliance) consumes SavingsAccountOpened for regulatory reporting
SVC-014 consumes SavingsAccountOpened for AML transaction monitoring setup
phases.exit_condition: SavingsAccount active; IsaSubscriptionRecord created (if ISA); SavingsAccountOpened published

phases.name: Initial Deposit and Confirmation
phases.description: Customer makes an initial deposit via internal transfer from their current account or an external transfer. The ISA subscription allowance is updated to reflect the deposit. Customer receives account confirmation with account number, AER, FSCS protection summary, and (for ISA) remaining allowance for the tax year.
persona_actions: Customer selects funding method: transfer from existing account or external deposit
system_actions: SVC-001 initiates deposit transfer (internal: same bank account; or external: via Faster Payments SVC-009)
On deposit confirmed: SVC-001 updates SavingsAccount.balance and IsaSubscriptionRecord.subscription_used (if ISA)
SVC-001 publishes IsaSubscriptionUpdated (EVT-150) if ISA deposit
SVC-001 publishes SavingsDepositMade (EVT-151)
SVC-053
SVC-103 records account opening and deposit in audit log
phases.exit_condition: Initial deposit credited; ISA subscription updated if applicable; confirmation dispatched

happy_path.description: Existing customer selects Cash ISA via mobile app. Passes ISA eligibility check (no prior ISA subscription this tax year). KYC is current. Application submitted. ISA account created. £5,000 initial deposit from current account. ISA subscription updated. Confirmation dispatched.

alternative_paths.name: Fixed-Term Savings Account
alternative_paths.description: Customer selects a fixed-term savings account (e.g. 1-year fixed, 2-year fixed). Additional terms apply: no withdrawals during the fixed term; rate fixed at account opening. Notice period for maturity instructions required.
additional_terms: Customer must set maturity instruction at opening: reinvest, transfer, or open new account

alternative_paths.name: New Customer — Full KYC Required
alternative_paths.description: Customer does not have an existing relationship with the bank. Full KYC/CDD performed: eIDV, sanctions screening, PEP check. Additional time required (typically 2-5 minutes). May require manual review if eIDV fails.

alternative_paths.name: ISA Transfer In
alternative_paths.description: Customer requests to transfer an existing ISA from another provider to this bank's Cash ISA. ISA transfer rules apply: transfer must preserve tax-free status. Provider-to-provider transfer form submitted. Existing ISA allowance usage is inherited.
additional_steps: Customer submits ISA transfer authority form
Bank contacts previous ISA provider to initiate transfer (30-day maximum transfer period)

exception_paths.name: ISA Allowance Exceeded
exception_paths.description: Customer has already subscribed the full £20,000 Cash ISA allowance for the current tax year (with this bank or another provider). Application is rejected with a clear regulatory explanation. Customer advised to wait until the new tax year.
exception_paths.trigger: IsaSubscriptionRecord.subscription_used + deposit_amount > 20000 OR existing ISA subscription with another provider confirmed
exception_paths.customer_message: You have reached your annual Cash ISA allowance of £20,000 for the current tax year. You can open a new Cash ISA from 6 April [next year].

exception_paths.name: KYC / eIDV Failure
exception_paths.description: Electronic identity verification fails (document mismatch, address not confirmed, sanctions hit). Application is placed in manual review. Customer is informed that additional verification is required. Human review by compliance team within 2 business days.
exception_paths.customer_message: We need to verify your identity before we can open your account. We will contact you within 2 business days.
exception_paths.internal_action: Application placed in manual review queue; PER-058 (KYC analyst) assigned

exception_paths.name: Initial Deposit Insufficient Funds
exception_paths.description: Internal transfer for initial deposit fails due to insufficient funds in the source current account. SavingsAccount is created in status = pending_deposit. Customer is notified to make a deposit within 30 days or the account will be closed.
exception_paths.trigger: Internal transfer fails: source account available balance < deposit amount
exception_paths.customer_message: Your account has been created but we could not process your initial deposit. Please make a deposit within 30 days to activate your account.

design_decisions.decision: ISA subscription allowance tracking (IsaSubscriptionRecord) is owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core), not a separate ISA service.
design_decisions.rationale: At current ISA product complexity (Cash ISA only), a separate ISA service adds unnecessary operational overhead. The IsaSubscriptionRecord is a projection of the savings account with tax-year accounting. If Stocks and Shares ISA or Lifetime ISA are added, a dedicated ISA service should be created.
design_decisions.rejected_because: Premature for a single ISA product type. Promotion criteria: multiple ISA product types, HMRC reporting requiring dedicated data model.

design_decisions.decision: HMRC ISA reporting is handled via the annual ISA return submitted by SVC-015 (Compliance), not via a real-time event to HMRC.
design_decisions.rationale: HMRC ISA reporting is an annual batch obligation — not a real-time requirement. Events drive internal state; annual return is a compliance artefact produced from the IsaSubscriptionRecord data at year-end.
